entities.name: PMID:25077412
observations: Prospective 2-D speckle-tracking study of 100 chronic severe systolic HF patients (LVEF ≤35%); compared LV twist, peak twist rate, and peak untwist rate across QRS-duration groups.

entities.name: QRS duration and LV twist
observations: In 100 HF patients with LVEF ≤35%, no association was found between QRS duration and LV twist, peak twist rate, or peak untwist rate (all P>0.05); group means were similar across <120, 120–150, and >150 ms.
